This is the default configuration for Tiny Tapeout projects. It should fit most designs.
If you change it, please make sure you understand what you are doing. We are not responsible
if your project fails because of a bad configuration.
!!! DO NOT EDIT THIS FILE unless you know what you are doing !!!
If you get stuck with this config, please open an issue or get in touch via the discord.
Here are some of the variables you may want to change:
PL_TARGET_DENSITY_PCT - You can increase this if Global Placement fails with error GPL-0302.
Users have reported that values up to 80 worked well for them.
CLOCK_PERIOD - Increase this in case you are getting setup time violations.
The value is in nanoseconds, so 20ns == 50MHz.
HISTORY 2026-08-27: 20 -> 25 ns, i.e. 50 MHz -> 40 MHz. That was a CORRECTION, not a
relaxation: the chip RUNS at 40 MHz (info.yaml clock_hz = 40000000, the VGA
800x600@60 pixel clock), so signing off at 20 ns constrained it 25% harder than
reality. At 20 ns setup repair started at WNS -4.957 ns over 53 violating endpoints
and only reached +0.064 ns -- 0.3% margin, which is not margin at all.
CHANGED 2026-08-31: 25 -> 22 ns. *** THE CHIP STILL RUNS AT 40 MHz. ***
22 ns is 45.45 MHz, which is NOT the operating frequency -- it is a deliberate
OVER-CONSTRAINT to buy margin at the slow PVT corner. Do not change info.yaml.
Why: at 25 ns the typical corner passed outright (RSZ-0098 no setup violations), so
repair_timing -setup never engaged at all -- while ss_100C_1v60 sat at -0.658 ns over
17 endpoints, every one of them inside u_fft. The offending paths are dominated by a
9-deep chain of clkdlybuf4s25_1 (a clock DELAY buffer, drive strength 1) inserted by
repair_design for max-fanout/slew, worth 9.06 ns of a 26.40 ns path. Constraining to
22 ns makes the typical corner violate, so setup repair finally attacks those paths
and can upsize/re-buffer them.
WATCH THE AREA: utilisation was 77.4% at 25 ns and the GDS render has failed at ~80%
before. If this pushes past ~78%, revert to 25 -- a render failure is far worse than
a slow-corner warning, and 25 ns ships fine (typical corner has +11.28 ns).
An RTL fanout fix was tried first and made things WORSE (see CLAUDE.md 2026-08-31).
Hold slack margin - Increase them in case you are getting hold violations.
RUN_LINTER, LINTER_INCLUDE_PDK_MODELS - Disabling the linter is not recommended!
If you need a custom clock configuration, read the following documentation first:
https://tinytapeout.com/faq/#how-can-i-map-an-additional-external-clock-to-one-of-the-gpios
Configuration docs: https://librelane.readthedocs.io/en/latest/reference/configuration.html
